facts.fact: The BCRG's First Deputy Governor cited the Guinéenne de Monétique as operator of the national switch and the NimbaPay instant payment system, in production since summer and linking seven institutions, among recent advances in the central bank's payment systems.

GIN.note: Nothing on consumer rules or redress.
Nothing on government payments to people.
PFMI is a payment-system standard, not an IT or data standard, and no standards body is named.
Only a strategy is being drafted; no law or rule stated.
Bank account share said to be below the regional average, with no figure or survey.

facts.fact: The BCRG's First Deputy Governor said the NimbaPay instant payment system has been in production since summer and already links seven institutions, with a second wave of connections being prepared.

GIN.note: Nothing on payment of taxes or fees.
